name: agentic-tdd-sdlc
description: Multi-model Agentic TDD SDLC workflow using Gemini 4 Argon for architecture, spec-generation, and final orchestrator/merge phases, and Gemini 4 Hydrogen for parallel ticket implementation and coding agents.

feature_slug.description: Short kebab-case identifier for the feature (e.g., 'auth-flow').

requirements.description: Initial feature requirements, problem description, or architecture notes.

base_branch.description: Base git branch to compare and integrate against.

architecture_model.description: Model used for initial architecture and requirement refinement.

spec_model.description: Model used for spec-generation (to-spec) and ticket DAG slicing (to-tickets).

coding_model.description: Model used for parallel ticket implementation and TDD coding agents.

implementation_model.description: Alias for coding_model used by parallel ticket implementation agents.

orchestrator_model.description: Model used for final orchestrator, branch merge, and two-axis review phases.

merge_model.description: Alias for orchestrator_model used during ticket branch merges.
